title: A simpler Vibe experience
summary: Chat and Work are merging into one Vibe experience, with fewer decisions and less navigation. Ask a question or start a task from the same place, without switching tabs.
whatsNew: The phased rollout starts September 14, 2026, with Free, Pro, and Teams accounts migrating progressively. Enterprise migration starts October 1, 2026, with administrators choosing when to migrate within an approximately six-month window.
keyCapabilities: One conversation list: Find your Chat and Work conversations together after your account migrates.
Fast or Think: Choose `Fast` for quick responses or `Think` for deeper reasoning in the message input, without leaving the conversation.
Skills: Use reusable instructions in place of Chat Agents. Deep Research is available as a Skill for source-backed research.
Knowledge Base: Your Chat Memories migrate into a knowledge topic that you can review and manage.
Temporary chat: Start a conversation without adding it to your history or Knowledge Base.
Code Interpreter: On paid plans, ask Work to run Python for calculations, data analysis, and charts.

getStarted.label: When your account has migrated, open Vibe and describe what you want to do. Follow the guide to start a task and review the result.
